prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern, high-tech office scene featuring a young man with short dark hair and glasses, dressed in a cream-colored sweatshirt, sitting at a sleek white desk. He is focused intently on his work, typing on a keyboard, with a serious and contemplative expression. The desk is illuminated by a stylish desk lamp, casting a warm, soft light that contrasts with the cool, ambient lighting of the room. A black coffee mug with white text sits beside him, and a large computer monitor displays code or technical content. Behind him, a large projection screen shows a detailed infographic titled "CREATING AI," with a blurred figure in business attire gesturing towards the screen, suggesting a collaborative or instructional environment. The background features dark walls, colorful bookshelves, and a prominent neon sign reading "AI" in bright yellow, adding a futuristic and creative atmosphere. The color palette blends cool blues and warm yellows, with a cinematic depth of field that keeps the foreground crisp and the background slightly out of focus, emphasizing the subject’s concentration and the innovative, tech-driven mood of the scene. The camera angle is slightly low and to the side, creating a dynamic composition that draws the viewer into the workspace.
